items.title: WHAT YOU HEAR
items.text:
WHAT YOU HEAR

Triangulation complete. We've picked up some chatter from the Hollow Men.

We've learned that they primarily use three frequencies:
9.2, 9.31, and 11.88. When we get the satellite towers fully operational (we predict this will happen around August), we will be able to listen in on their signals.

Keep this in the reserve.

mechanics.effect: Keep this report in the reserve. It names the three Hollow Men frequencies.
